/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
human=''
def lev(a,b):
 if len(a)<len(b): a,b=b,a
 prev=list(range(len(b)+1))
 for i,ca in enumerate(a,1):
  cur=[i]
  for j,cb in enumerate(b,1):
   cur.append(min(prev[j]+1,cur[-1]+1,prev[j-1]+(ca"'!=cb)))
  prev=cur
 return prev[-1]
for f in ['"'indri_blast.tsv','semjoh_blast.tsv']:
 print(f)
 line=open(f).read().strip().splitlines()[0]
 cols=line.split('\\t')
 print(cols[:13])
 q=cols[9]; s=cols[10]
 print('qlen',len(q),'slen',len(s),'mismatch',cols[5],'gapopen',cols[6])
 print('q',q)
 print('s',s)
 print('lev(q,s)',lev(q,s),'lev(s,human)',lev(s,human),'mismatch count',sum(a"'!=b for a,b in zip(q,s)))
PY'
